name: westworld
description: Westworld - AI 漫画生成站(文本 → 分镜 → 漫画格)。Monorepo: backend(NestJS) + frontend(Vue3)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
